title: UiKit slot
description: A prop the consumer supplies whose type this schema cannot assert - a growth point declared at the component level instead of enumerating every prop a plugin author might touch (DataTable's `columns` accepts arbitrary third-party ColumnDefs, whose own render functions are opaque to a JSON Schema extractor regardless of how many are listed).

prop.description: Name of a prop declared by the component, not a type id. Checked against the extracted prop list by the conformance test.
